title: Bleak House
author: Charles Dickens
summary: A long-running inheritance case, Jarndyce and Jarndyce, drags on in the English Court of Chancery and touches many lives. Esther Summerson narrates part of the story, while secrets about her origins slowly emerge.
readIf: you like big Victorian novels with large casts, social criticism and a thread of mystery.
skipIf: you want brisk plotting or find long digressive Victorian prose wearing.
